`skill-creator` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Creates, migrates, edits, validates, and reviews Consuelo OS skills, including SKILL.md guidance, skill.json metadata, registry wiring, install behavior, and tests.

## When to use it

Use this OS operator skill when creating, migrating, editing, validating, or reviewing opensaas/Consuelo OS skills. It turns skill workflows into repo-backed skill folders, skill.json metadata, migration fixtures, replacement allowlists, registry generation, install seeding, and tests, with exact-copy guardrails unless Ko explicitly approves a rewrite.

Typical requests include:

- “Turn this repeated workflow into an OS skill.”
- “Migrate this skill without losing its existing operating instructions.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill skill-creator
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill skill-creator
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

This skill is for Consuelo OS skills. Preserve known-good guidance during migrations; rewrite only when the intended workflow actually changes.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md` exists and that `skill-creator` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `skill-creator` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
